# install: research chezmoi and other dotfiles managers

Evaluate [chezmoi](https://github.com/twpayne/chezmoi) — and, by extension, the other dotfiles managers (yadm, GNU Stow, Nix home-manager, bare-repo setups) — as a replacement for the hand-written [install](../../install)/[self-update](../../bin/self-update) pair. chezmoi offers templating per machine, secret integration (1Password among others), a diff/apply model and a single binary, i.e. the things the current scripts approximate with per-host Brewfiles, `git reset --hard` and ad-hoc `source` lines.
